Most of London's tap water is river water 💧
Thames Water says rivers give about 70% of its supply across London and the Thames Valley: the Thames, Lee, Kennet, Wey and Tillingbourne. River water is pumped into big reservoirs in West and North London. The rest, up to 30%, comes from underground, mostly chalk, and in a drought that can rise to 40%.
